use_case: A Slack teammate that remembers company knowledge, researches questions, and works through connected tools.
not_for: Direct execution inside a Harbor task container without a task adapter.
Offline company-memory tasks without a configured memory service.
evidence: README.md; src/brain/turn/agent.ts and agent.impl.ts (Cloudflare Durable Object and debugTurn); src/routes/index.ts (HTTP routes); src/brain/tools/sandbox/{availability,client}.ts (Cloudflare/Daytona file tools); src/brain/turn/brain-model.ts (model clients). Capabilities describe the application with its required services configured.
source: source review and isolated Docker checks

compatibility.summary: Added for evaluation. The application builds, its Bun tests pass, and it starts locally; benchmark runs need a Cloudflare task adapter.
blockers: Task delivery: the release accepts Slack events and internal worker calls, but has no command-line task entrypoint. An adapter must submit a task and capture completion.
Task files: its shell and file tools use Cloudflare or Daytona sandboxes. They need access to the same files and state that the benchmark grader examines.
Memory and tools: evaluation needs isolated company data, memory-service access, and task-scoped connections. These were not provisioned by the setup checks.
